settings.heading: Why Choose the Corro-Protec Powered Anode Rod ?

settings.text:
The Corro-Protec anode, which has proven its effectiveness since 2006, was designed to address several common water heater issues, such as corrosion, leaks, and unpleasant odors. Here are its main benefits:

  • Eliminates sulfur smell within 24 hours
    If you’ve ever noticed a rotten egg smell when using your hot water, you know how unpleasant it can be. The Corro-Protec anode quickly neutralizes the bacteria responsible for this odor, leaving your water cleaner and more pleasant in less than 24 hours.
  • Prevents corrosion and extends the lifespan of your water heater
    By effectively stopping internal corrosion, this anode doubles the lifespan of your water heater. It acts as a protective barrier against internal damage, preventing costly leaks.
  • Reduces sediment and scale buildup
    By reducing the buildup of sediment and scale, your water heater operates more efficiently, improving both its performance and longevity.
  • 20-year warranty
    The Corro-Protec anode comes with a 20-year warranty, ensuring its durability and reliability over the long term.
  • Made in Canada
    By choosing Corro-Protec, you're supporting a trusted Canadian brand known for the quality and innovation of its products.

settings.heading: Easy Installation and Long-Term Peace of Mind

settings.text: Installing the Corro-Protec anode is simple and requires just a few steps. First, remove your current sacrificial anode from the water heater and replace it with the Corro-Protec anode. Then, plug the anode's power cord into a wall outlet. This creates an impressed current that actively protects the tank from corrosion, giving you peace of mind for many years to come.
